title: StrictLocalMateProjectionData
statement: For f:X→S, a geometric point s, K in D⁺(Ab(X_et)), integer n and canonical geometry Q [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-neighbourhood-geometry], define the section homology map of the derived base-change mate and its exact-sections Leray target isomorphism. StrictLocalMateProjectionData gives stage identifications from derived sections of Rf_*K [def-weil-pbc-canonical-derived-cohomology-germs] to neighbourhood hypercohomology, compatible with transition pullbacks, and identifies each canonical small-model source leg [def-weil-pbc-small-model-cohomology-germs] followed by the mate with projection pullback followed by the inverse target isomorphism. It does not include a source or target colimit assertion.

source.place: Tags 03Q9, 03Q8 and 0BKV; neighbourhood colimit and final injective-complex paragraph

proof.text: Use the general pointed-section-cone restriction on strictLocalSectionCone, the existing exact-sections instance for the small colimit model, and the general exact-global-sections Leray comparison wherever the former specialized restriction API was used. The cone restriction has the same section formulas, its germ predicate is definitionally identical, and uniqueness identifies the chosen stalk maps. All other argument steps and all scheme models stay as before.

The geometry parameter is now the official canonical strictLocalization model. Use [lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-small-model-geometry-transport] to express its cone on the original small colimit model. Replace legs, limit and the two component equations by smallModelLegs, smallModelIsLimit, smallModelFirst and smallModelOver. All cohomology objects, structural morphisms, source and target maps remain those in the original statement; the rest of the existing proof is unchanged.
Use the small-model germ legs without changing their component maps. The adopted six common derived-sections constructions are definitionally identical to the former local copies.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight results about structure-sheaf stalks and ordinary module pullback; none realizes these abelian derived-section maps. Loogle presheafToSheaf, homology and IsPullback, IsAffineHom queries returned no hits.

Mathlib has general stalk and pullback infrastructure, but no strict-local derived mate or the canonical derived Hom-to-germ comparison. The existing AbelianHigherDirectImagePresheaf has private definitions of the comparison, inaccessible from another module.
